subject: english
chapter: From the Diary of Anne Frank

hint: Look at the very first sentences of the extract.
explanation: Anne says it is strange not only because she has never written anything before, but also because she believes later neither she nor anyone else will be interested in the thoughts of a thirteen-year-old. options.text: She has nothing to say, and her teacher has forbidden her to write.
She has never written anything before, and she thinks nobody will care about a schoolgirl's musings later.
She finds writing boring, and her sister keeps reading her pages.

subject: english

options.text: Paper lasts for many more years than people do.
People write faster than paper can take in the ink.

options.text: She has a need to get all kinds of things off her chest.
She wants the diary itself to become her friend, Kitty.
Her teacher has asked every pupil to keep a diary.
She wants to note down only dry facts, as most people do.
